result.instructions: Tools for ChannelEngine, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which orders are new in ChannelEngine right now?"; "Show me the stock level of product SKU 12345 in every stock location."; "List the returns from the last 7 days that are not acknowledged yet.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes ChannelEngine data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run channelengine_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run channelengine_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run channelengine_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. channelengine_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: channelengine_list_channels
tools.title: List channels
tools.description: List the marketplaces and webshops (channels) connected to this merchant account, with their ids. Good first call: channel ids are used by the other filters. Merchant API: GET /api/v2/channels.

tools.name: channelengine_get_settings
tools.title: Get account settings
tools.description: Get the merchant account settings in ChannelEngine. Merchant API: GET /api/v2/settings.

tools.name: channelengine_list_stock_locations
tools.title: List stock locations
tools.description: List the stock locations (warehouses) of this merchant account, with their ids. Merchant API: GET /api/v2/stocklocations.

tools.name: channelengine_list_orders
tools.title: List orders
tools.description: List orders with filters: status, order numbers, channel, order date range and acknowledgement state. Returns Content plus TotalCount. Merchant API: GET /api/v2/orders.

statuses.description: Filter on one or more order statuses (for example NEW, IN_PROGRESS or SHIPPED). AWAITING_PAYMENT orders are excluded unless listed.

merchant_order_nos.description: Filter on one or more merchant order numbers.

channel_order_nos.description: Filter on one or more channel order numbers.

channel_ids.description: Filter on one or more channel ids (see channelengine_list_channels).

tools.name: channelengine_get_new_orders
tools.title: Get new orders
tools.description: Get the orders that are new and not yet processed by the merchant (the usual order-intake call). Merchant API: GET /api/v2/orders/new.

stock_location_id.description: Only orders for this stock location id.

tools.name: channelengine_acknowledge_order
tools.title: Acknowledge order (write)
tools.description: WRITE: acknowledge one order, which tells the channel the merchant accepted it. Needs the ChannelEngine OrderId (from channelengine_list_orders). Optionally sets your own MerchantOrderNo on it. Merchant API: POST /api/v2/orders/acknowledge.

order_id.description: The ChannelEngine order id (the Id field of the order).

merchant_order_no.description: Your own order reference to store on the order.

tools.name: channelengine_list_products
tools.title: List products
tools.description: Search the merchant product catalogue by name, merchant product number, EAN or brand, or by explicit lists of product numbers or EANs. Merchant API: GET /api/v2/products.

search.description: Search by name, merchant product number, EAN or brand.

eans.description: Filter on one or more EAN codes.

merchant_product_nos.description: Filter on one or more merchant product numbers (SKUs).

tools.name: channelengine_get_product
tools.title: Get product
tools.description: Get one product by its merchant product number (SKU). Merchant API: GET /api/v2/products/{merchantProductNo}.

tools.name: channelengine_list_channel_listings
tools.title: List products on a channel
tools.description: List the products listed on one channel (marketplace or webshop), optionally for given merchant product numbers. Merchant API: GET /api/v2/channels/{channelId}/products.

merchant_product_nos.description: Filter on one or more merchant product numbers (SKUs).

tools.name: channelengine_get_stock
tools.title: Get stock levels
tools.description: Get the stock level per product across all stock locations. Pages start at index 0 here. Merchant API: GET /api/v2/offer/stock.

skus.description: Filter on one or more product SKUs (merchant product numbers).

stock_location_ids.description: Filter on one or more stock location ids.

tools.name: channelengine_update_stock
tools.title: Update stock levels (write)
tools.description: WRITE: set the absolute stock for products at stock locations. This changes live stock on every connected channel. Send the full stock per location, not a change. Merchant API: PUT /api/v2/offer/stock.

updates.description: Stock updates, one entry per product (max 100).

tools.name: channelengine_list_shipments
tools.title: List shipments
tools.description: List shipments created for merchant orders, with filters on order, shipment, create date and channel. Merchant API: GET /api/v2/shipments/merchant.

merchant_order_nos.description: Filter on one or more merchant order numbers.

merchant_shipment_nos.description: Filter on one or more merchant shipment numbers.

channel_order_nos.description: Filter on one or more channel order numbers.

channel_id.description: Only shipments for this channel id.

tools.name: channelengine_list_returns
tools.title: List returns
tools.description: List returns for merchant orders, with filters on channel, order, status, date and acknowledgement. Merchant API: GET /api/v2/returns/merchant.

channel_ids.description: Filter on one or more channel ids.

merchant_order_nos.description: Filter on one or more merchant order numbers.

channel_order_nos.description: Filter on one or more channel order numbers.

statuses.description: Filter on one or more return statuses.

tools.name: channelengine_list_cancellations
tools.title: List cancellations
tools.description: List order cancellations for this merchant, with filters on creation date and order numbers. Merchant API: GET /api/v2/cancellations/merchant.

merchant_order_nos.description: Filter on one or more merchant order numbers.

channel_order_nos.description: Filter on one or more channel order numbers.

tools.name: channelengine_list_notifications
tools.title: List notifications
tools.description: List notifications ChannelEngine raised for this merchant (for example order or shipment problems), with date and order filters. Merchant API: GET /api/v2/notifications.

types.description: Filter on one or more notification types.

merchant_order_nos.description: Filter on one or more merchant order numbers.

channel_order_nos.description: Filter on one or more channel order numbers.

prompts.name: getting_started
prompts.title: Get started with ChannelEngine
prompts.description: What you can do with ChannelEngine here, with example requests to try.
